links.outcome: Calibration (empirical coverage) of volumetric 95% credible intervals across segmentation models
links.effect: Heterogeneous EDL ensemble produced the most reliable credible intervals, capturing true tumor volume in 92.8% of cases against a 95% target.
links.quote: Out of all models tested, the heterogeneous EDL ensemble produced the most reliable volumetric credible intervals, capturing the true tumor volume in 92.8% of cases.

links.outcome: Segmentation performance on an independent external institution cohort
links.effect: External cohort of 353 patients with meningioma achieved median Dice 0.92, versus about 0.93 in the internal test set.
links.quote: External validation on an independent external cohort of 353 patients with meningioma confirmed high generalizability, achieving a median Dice of0.92.

unlisted_practices: Evidential deep learning ensembles with architectural diversity for calibrated segmentation uncertainty
Spatial uncertainty maps compared with neuroradiologist-defined ambiguity

screen.reason: Evaluates an evidential deep learning ensemble to provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and credible intervals for safer clinical deployment of brain tumor segmentation.
